visualCharacteristics.purpose: centred feature columns: icon, heading, short description and a link

contentPattern.structure: one row with one cell per feature (or one feature per row). Each cell: icon or image, heading, text, link

usage: Product cross-sell features (e.g. savings / investing) with centred icons
reuseGuidance: Use for 2-4 centred icon features. Not for contact panels (columns-contact).
